title: Sarkopenia and physical activity in acute geriatric psychiatry
summary: Correlations between the incidence and severity of sarcopenia and the physical activity of patients with delirium superimposed on dementia, dementia or depression will me analysed. Secondary, disease-specific parameters will be corellated with said aspects.
conditions: Dementia in other diseases classified elsewhere

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1) Icd-10 diagnosis of delrium superimposed on dementia, dementia or depression
2) consent to participate (confirmed by written consent either by patient or legal guardian)
3) ability to perform simple mobility tasks (ability to walk at elast 4 metres without support)
Exclusion criteria:
1) no written or general consent to participate
2) Immobility
